data-structures--structure.title: struct definition, instance and member access
lines: struct point {          /* type definition: no storage yet */
data-structures--structure.note: The definition only describes the layout; memory is reserved when a variable such as p is declared.

data-structures--typedef.title: typedef naming an untagged structure
data-structures--typedef.note: Student is an alias for the unnamed struct, so the keyword struct is not repeated at every use.

data-structures--enumerated-data-type.title: enum values with one explicit initialiser
lines: enum day { MON = 1, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT, SUN };
data-structures--enumerated-data-type.note: Only MON is given a value; each later name takes the previous value plus one, so WED is 3 and SUN is 7.

data-structures--malloc.title: allocating n elements and testing the result
lines: int *a = malloc(n * sizeof *a);   /* n ints, uninitialised */
data-structures--malloc.note: Writing sizeof *a keeps the request correct if the element type changes, and the NULL test guards the failure case.

data-structures--union.title: union members share one storage area
data-structures--union.note: All three members start at the same address, so writing one overwrites the others and the size is the largest member.

data-structures--self-referential-struct.title: a structure holding a pointer to its own type
lines: struct node *next;   /* points to the same type */
data-structures--self-referential-struct.note: The member is a pointer rather than a struct node, so the type does not contain itself and its size stays finite.

data-structures--array-representation-of.title: level-order array for a seven-node tree
data-structures--array-representation-of.note: Children sit at 2i+1 and 2i+2 and the parent at floor((i-1)/2), so a missing node still costs a cell.

data-structures--depth-first-search.title: recursive DFS over an adjacency matrix
data-structures--depth-first-search.note: The call stack replaces an explicit stack: each call dives into one neighbour and returns only when that branch is exhausted.
